candidates.title: OpenJDK Base64 decoding heap corruption with AVX-512 enabled
candidates.summary: OpenJDK and many downstream Java implementations do not securely decode Base64 data when x86 or x64 CPU AVX-512 extensions are enabled. An attacker with the ability to control Base64 input may be able to manipulate heap memory to cause a Java process to crash or execute arbitrary code. In many cases attacks can be attempted remotely and without authentication. Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, and Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition are affected.
